senses.gloss: m. pl. (פְּצַל) shrivelled fruit, esp. grapes which fell in an unripe state and were put in the sun to ripen (cmp. פַּצְעִילִין).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:1:5">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>באילין פ׳ הוה עובדא</he> the question turned on the sun-dried grapes; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:5:4">Y. Maasr. I, end, 49ᵇ</cite> <he>באילין פצולי אילין הוה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
